candidate.name: int8_direct_prefill_sequential
candidate.mechanism: prefill full-attention reads the retained INT8 K/V store directly with Hadamard-group32 fp16 scales on the four INT8 tail layers through the sequential online-softmax kernel, removing the BF16 oracle pair and the AOTriton bridge
